evidence.quote: At Hof University, no tuition fees are charged for our Bachelor's and Master's programs.

notes: Tuition: the quoted no-tuition-fees statement is institution-wide for Bachelor's and Master's programs; it is used here for this Bachelor programme. Application channel: the pages say foreign school-leaving certificates must first be assessed by uni-assist (VPD), then you apply in PRIMUSS; 'de-uni-assist-vpd' was chosen for the pre-review VPD route. Intakes: the DAAD page states the period applies to 'applicants from: all countries'; the programme page states the same period without a year, so it is given as a recurring deadline (recurringDeadline) and no year is invented. A later submission date of 15 September for language certificates exists but is not an application deadline.

evidence.quote: In addition: German language skills, proven by official test score documents - minimum level A1
